meta.title: Update all
meta.description: Adds a one-click "lazy update" sidebar entry: updates every installed plugin that has a newer version in one go, puts plugins that are still inside the release maturity hold into their own waiting category, outside the update run and never retryable, installs over plugins the desktop app refuses to hot-remove and asks for a restart to apply them, reloads the page after client-only updates so a new session cannot hit two module versions, offers a one-click DSH restart when the Host half changed, and hands off to the desktop app's built-in updater when an app update is available.
